tldr: Saturn through the 7th house pressurizes partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When Saturn moves through your 7th house, it makes partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you harder to ignore. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

Limits, responsibilities, commitments, and consequences may be harder to avoid. It can help you build something that holds up because you are finally dealing with the reality of it.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for mistaking pressure for failure, or treating delay as proof that nothing is working. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

Saturn moves through this house for a long season. Move slowly and take the responsibility seriously. The pressure is showing what needs structure.
